Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

textshaping (development version)

  • Add LaTeX and Typst math shaping (at least a large subset of it)
  • Font variations (variable font axis coordinates) now travel through shaping. shape_text() and text_width() gain a variation argument accepting systemfonts::font_variation() objects. The C API has been extended with textshaping::ver2::string_width() and textshaping::ver2::string_shape() that take FontSettings2; the existing FontSettings-based entry points remain available unchanged during the transition.

Crash and memory-safety fixes

  • Fixed a crash (and a potential infinite loop) when a forced line break was needed on a line too narrow for a single glyph, both left-to-right and right-to-left
  • Fixed a crash when shaping an empty string with justified alignment
  • Fixed a crash when calculating the width of an empty string with include_bearing = FALSE
  • Fixed a crash (integer division by zero) with distributed alignment on lines containing a single glyph
  • Fixed a heap corruption when text contained more bidi embedding levels than the embedding stack had room for; the stack now grows on demand
  • Fixed use-after-free and double-free bugs in font loading on systems where the FreeType versions of systemfonts and textshaping differ
  • Fixed an out-of-bounds read when converting truncated or invalid UTF-8 input to codepoints
  • Fixed a format-string vulnerability where user-provided math input was passed as the format string of an error message
  • Fixed FreeType face leaks in get_font_features() and in math layout, and made font and library handles exception-safe so they can’t leak on error paths
  • Fixed a leak of the global shaper after package unload/reload; C-callable entry points now lazily recreate it instead of risking a use-after-free
  • Fixed a leak of the HarfBuzz font when hyphen substitution failed
  • Handle-owning C++ classes can no longer be copied (which would have led to double frees)
  • Guarded against undefined behaviour when converting non-finite or out-of-range doubles (widths, indents, sizes, etc.) to integers
  • Fixed potential out-of-bounds reads on fonts without a family name and on bitmap fonts reporting a zero strike height

Shaping correctness fixes

  • The shape cache now stores glyph clusters relative to the run start, so cached shaping is correct when the same run appears at different positions in a paragraph; previously, stale paragraph positions could leak into subsequent shaping and lead to out-of-bounds reads
  • Cache keys for shaping, bidi, and math layout now compare the actual string content rather than only a hash, so a hash collision can no longer silently return another string’s result
  • Fixed emoji handling in left-to-right text: emoji detection no longer relies on negating the embedding level (a no-op for level 0) and now uses the correct paragraph offset
  • Fixed an error (“Can’t combine embeddings past termination point”) when an rtl embedding ended a paragraph; rtl runs are now merged in reverse order rather than reversing first
  • Fixed fallback sizing tables getting out of sync with the fallback font list when an existing font was retried, leading to wrong scaling, tracking, and sizes
  • Fixed shaping failures leaving half-built embeddings behind that could be indexed out of bounds downstream
  • Single-character strings now resolve their direction through the bidi algorithm, so ltr is reported correctly
  • Fixed hyphen kerning being computed against a Unicode codepoint rather than a glyph id
  • Fixed the line-break glyph advance being subtracted from the wrong end in right-to-left embeddings
  • Fixed the glyph-per-line count in justified alignment being off by one
  • Fixed the “largest strike” selection for bitmap fonts never being updated
  • Feature tags shorter or longer than 4 characters are now padded or rejected instead of being read out of bounds, and mismatched tag/setting lengths are caught early
  • The exported C API ts_string_shape2() now fills the cluster output and clears all outputs on error
  • Fixed reading include_bearing from the wrong element and treating NA as TRUE in text_width()
  • Fixed a potential crash when the last line of a paragraph ended in a hard line break
  • Font and shaping failures during a paragraph are now reported as errors when finalising shaping instead of silently dropping the failed text
  • The bidi algorithm now falls back to neutral embeddings if analysis fails, rather than returning uninitialised embedding levels

Math (LaTeX/Typst) fixes

  • Fixed two infinite loops in the Typst parser ({...} groups with unexpected tokens and mat(augment: #(...)) with non-identifier entries)
  • Deeply nested math input now raises a parse error instead of crashing R with a stack overflow (both parsers are depth-limited)
  • Typst backslash sequences now work: escaped delimiters (\(, \,, …), and \ line breaks, which were previously dead code
  • The Typst parser now reports unexpected trailing content instead of silently dropping it (e.g. after ,, :, ;, or non-ASCII input)
  • Typst primes (f'(x)), parenthesised comma lists (f(x, y)), subscripts on identifiers (x_1), and multi-letter identifiers (xy) now parse correctly
  • root(n, x) no longer swaps the index and radicand
  • Ragged and empty cells in Typst mat()/cases() no longer shift or lose columns, and cases() keeps its condition column
  • Typst row-gap:/column-gap: matrix parameters now work (‘-’ was being rewritten to a minus sign before the parameter name was checked)
  • mat(augment:) now accepts negative values and arrays of positions
  • lr(|x|) no longer swallows the closing delimiter into the content
  • attach(x, t:, b:) now renders instead of producing nothing
  • Parentheses used for grouping in Typst scripts (x^(a+b)) are stripped as Typst does
  • LaTeX \displaystyle (and friends) now stop at \right, &, \\, and \end instead of swallowing the rest of the group
  • LaTeX \text{} and \operatorname{} now preserve spaces and backslashes by copying the raw input
  • LaTeX non-ASCII input is now rendered instead of silently dropped
  • LaTeX f'^2 now puts the prime and the 2 in the same superscript in the right order
  • Fixed get_math_glyph_variants() and get_math_glyph_assembly() always returning empty results
  • Glyph assemblies from MATH tables are now capped in size, centred around the middle piece, and no longer risk undefined behaviour on infinite or huge target sizes
  • \rule no longer accepts infinite or NaN dimensions
  • Text in \text{}, strings, and operator names is now decoded as UTF-8 instead of byte by byte
  • Em-based spacing and matrix gaps in math layout now scale with the device resolution, matching the glyph metrics
  • Typst phi/epsilon and their .alt variants now follow Typst’s conventions rather than LaTeX’s, and a duplicate diamond.stroked symbol table key was removed
  • Font variations and MATH table queries now handle the res argument and guard against invalid font sizes
  • The LaTeX/Typst syntax detector no longer misclassifies LaTeX thin spaces (\,, \;, \!, \:) as Typst escapes when LaTeX commands are present

Build fixes

  • Fixed the NO_HARFBUZZ_FRIBIDI fallback build (stub signature mismatches and an undeclared constant)
  • Removed the all: clean rule from Makevars.in that forced full rebuilds on every compile and was racy under parallel make
  • Windows build now defines NDEBUG and FRIBIDI_LIB_STATIC consistently with the Unix build

textshaping 1.0.52026-03-06

  • Fixed a bug when reverting back from one fallback to the previous one (#76)

textshaping 1.0.42025-10-10

  • Guard against issues related to incompatible versions of freetype in systemfonts and textshaping (#68).

textshaping 1.0.32025-09-02

  • Fixed a signed integer overflow in the fix for ragg#193

textshaping 1.0.22025-09-01

  • Fixed a bug in bidi embedding arrangement when shaping a single line (ggplot2#6497)
  • Fixed a bug in shape caching due to a weak vector hash implementation (ragg#193)
  • Fixed a bug in line positioning when line containes mix of different sizes

textshaping 1.0.12025-05-01

  • Fixed a bug where hard line breaks where ignored if the line consisted of multiple embeddings (marquee#58)
  • Fixed a bug where newline characters would increase the width of a line and lead to an empty line getting inserted in some situations (marquee#55)

textshaping 1.0.02025-01-20

  • Added lorem_text() and lorem_bidi() for generating nonsense text in various scripts
  • Added plot_shape() to plot the result of a shaping along with the metrics
  • Rewrite of the shaping engine to honor global direction of text. It introduces a direction argument to shape_text() that defaults to auto, meaning that it is deduced from the content of the shaped text. align gets two new settings that responds to the global direction of the text. "auto" will chose between "left" and "right" and "justified" will choose between "justified-left" and "justified-right" depending of the global direction is ltr or rtl. Lastly the soft break locations are now based on ICU and thus better support ideographic scripts such as Han/Kanji/Hangul.
  • Textshaping now properly supports soft hyphens in that a hyphen is rendered if a soft-wrap happens at a soft hyphen (#52)

textshaping 0.4.12024-12-06

  • Make compiled code somewhat less assumptive about the correctness of the input
  • Fix a bug from too aggressive early exiting shaping of strings with no max width (#45)
  • Fixed a mismatch between the default values of the width argument in shape_text() and systemfonts::match_fonts() (#44)
  • Updated text_width() to take the same inputs as shape_text()

textshaping 0.4.02024-05-24

  • Full rewrite of shape_text() to allow proper font-fallback, bidi text support, support for font-features, spacers, new align settings, etc.

textshaping 0.3.72023-10-09

  • Prepare for Arm Windows

textshaping 0.3.62021-10-13

  • Fix a bug in fallback font loading which would crash the process if the font failed to load (#23)
  • Fixed bug that would reset fallback to the original font for short strings (#25)

textshaping 0.3.52021-06-09

  • Address an UBCSAN issue in packages linking to textshaping
  • Remove a few compiler warnings

textshaping 0.3.42021-05-11

  • Prepare textshaping for UCRT support
  • Address upstream changes in cpp11

textshaping 0.3.32021-03-16

  • Support static linking on macOS (#17, @jeroen)

textshaping 0.3.22021-03-10

  • Avoid overindexing fallbacks when no fallback is found

textshaping 0.3.12021-02-22

  • Try to avoid ASAN issue reported by CRAN

textshaping 0.3.02021-02-10

  • Add support for performing font fallback as part of the single-line shaping
  • Provide support for non-scalable fonts

textshaping 0.2.12020-11-13

  • Fix issues with the Solaris mock solution

textshaping 0.2.02020-11-12

  • Update C API to prepare for font fallback
  • Make sure it compiles on Solaris without system dependencies

textshaping 0.1.22020-10-08

  • Fix a bug in the interaction with the systemfonts font cache that could cause random crashes on some mac installations.

textshaping 0.1.12020-09-29

  • Small changes to comply with next cpp11 version

textshaping 0.1.02020-09-17

  • First release. Provide access to HarfBuzz shaping and FriBidi bidirectional script support.
